title: Lab: automate a personal task using a no-code AI workflow
body:
🛠 Lab exercise

Design (on paper, or actually build if you have access to a no-code platform) a simple AI-powered automation for a real task in your own life. Sketch out:

  1. The trigger — what starts the workflow (a new email, a form submission, a scheduled time).
  2. The AI step — what you want the AI to do with the content (summarize, classify, draft a reply, extract data).
  3. The action — what happens with the AI's output (send a notification, save to a spreadsheet, post to a channel).
